FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about contacting and getting assistance from Abhi Cabs.

Call us, message us on WhatsApp, email us, or use the contact form on this page. All options are listed at the top of this page.

Open My Booking and look up your trip with your Booking ID, or send us a message here with the subject “Booking Assistance” and include your Booking ID.

Enter your trip in the booking form on the Home or Services page to see the fare for your route. For anything else, choose “Fare and Pricing Enquiry” in the contact form.

Use “Corporate Enquiry” in the Business section of this page. It opens the contact form with the subject already selected.
